disputes.description: Raw C body of 0x00551830 uses narrow strcmp on char buffers, not any wide/unicode comparison; the filename 'WideStringComparisonWalkingLinkedList' is misleading and must not be carried into promoted contracts.

0x0058815F name claims a buffer-overflow check, but the only local guard decrements a 0x7FFFFFFF counter and can never fire in practice; real bounds handling lives outside the packet in sub_58D04D/sub_58CF35.

0x00556650 is labeled __thiscall yet 0x005665B0 shows a bare 'StringCopyWithBufferRealloc(a2)' call in its empty-buffer branch; the decompiler likely dropped an implicit ecx=this, but the ABI relationship is unconfirmed from this packet alone.
